about_the_game:
Astro combat (Demo Version) includes the entire first and second chapters of the game. To give players a better early experience, the  (character draw) system has been unlocked earlier than planned. Whether the unlock timing will be adjusted in the full release will depend on player feedback.

After extensive testing, the demo version's initial draws have a high chance of granting all characters, allowing players to enjoy powerful fighters and dominate the battlefield!

Note: (character draw) resources are obtained entirely through gameplay—there are no microtransactions in the demo, and the full version won’t have any either!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i7+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: This is an "Arcade-style Beat 'em Up" with "Real-time Tactics" and "Action RPG" elements. Choose to engage in a rampage or opt for stealth. After the main story, explore regions, collect items, battle foes, and develop your team.
